title: The beautiful ineffectual dreamer who comes to grief against hard facts
html_source:
Gifford: taken from remarks of Meister about Hamlet but which also apply to Meister himself.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: The novel “Wilhelm Meister’s Apprenticeship” is just fiction. Although some people believe that parts of Goethe’s life influenced parts of the book.
